segments.text: Good evening. This is Akash Vani. I'm Shagun Chopra with the news at 9.
The headlines
Government approves setting up of Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority to streamline
multimodal planning. Clear 10,000 crore rupees, small and medium enterprises growth
fund, Prime Minister Narendra Modi hails decision as major boost to MSME sector.
Union Cabinet congratulates Prime Minister Narendra Modi on completing 25 years if
continuous leadership as head of the government. Defense Ministry inked 660 crore rupee contract
to procure BrahMos fire control system and launchers for Indian Navy ships. Peaceful
polling held for by-elections to five assembly constituencies in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and
West Bengal and Nagau Lok Sabha seat in Nassam results on Friday. Belgian-born scientist
Francis Hobson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for discovery of high-energy neutrinos of
astrophysical origin.
In Men's Cricket, West Indies set a target of 172 runs for India in first T20 of Five
Math series in Lucknow.
And now the news in detail.
The Union Cabinet has approved the setting up of Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority
to streamline multimodal planning. Briefing media in New Delhi today after the Cabinet
meeting, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, information and broadcasting Minister
Ashwini Vaishnav said the body will prepare a long-term national transport master plan
with a horizon of 10 years. He said it will serve as the apex body for integrated transport
and logistic planning in the country.
As the country's GDP is growing at a rate of around 7-8%, the demand for logistics is
also continuously increasing.
A large number of highways are being constructed across the country along with new railway
lines, waterways, ports and airports.
To ensure that all these developments are planned in an integrated and unified manner,
the Prime Minister launched the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan three years ago.
Now, keeping future requirements in mind, an integrated transport and logistics authority
will be established to study and plan all these aspects.
Mr. Vaishnav said the Cabinet has also given note to the establishment of Rs. 10,000 crore
small and medium enterprises growth fund for equity investments in small and medium
enterprises.
A 10,000 crore rupees MSME growth fund will be established to provide long-term equity
capital to MSMEs with strong growth potential.
The fund will be operated with the support of the Ministry of MSME and the Ministry of
Finance and will be professionally managed to ensure effective allocation of capital.
The fund will place a strong emphasis on manufacturing-focused MSMEs with nearly
half of its corpus expected to be directed towards the manufacturing sector.
This focus aims to support MSMEs in leveraging the significant growth opportunities emerging
in the sector.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi in a social media post said, this cabinet decision is a big
boost for MSME sector and a major step towards creating the next generation of Indian business
leaders.
He added that the integrated transport and logistics authority approved by the cabinet
will bring greater coordination, data-led planning and multimodal integration across
India's transport ecosystem.
Prime Minister Modi has emphasized that technology must become a tool for inclusive and sustainable
development.
Mr. Modi stated this while interacting with Global's System for Mobile Communications
Association board members at Sevatiith today ahead of the India Mobile Congress.
The India Mobile Congress is scheduled to be held from 7th to 10th of this month
in New Delhi.
He emphasised the need to make technology and digital services affordable and accessible,
particularly for the global south and highlighted the importance of taking technology to the
last mile to prevent a widening digital divide.
The Ministry of Defence has signed a contract worth over Rs 660 crore with BrahMos Aerospace
Private Limited for procurement of BrahMos fire control system and launchers for Indian
Navy ships.
The contract, under the buy Indian indigenously designed, developed and manufactured category,
was inked in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh in New Delhi.
With a minimum of 68% of indigenous content, the project encourages active participation
of various Indian industries, including MSMEs.
The Brahmos system fitted on board various frontline warships is the Indian Navy's primary
surface-to-surface missile system for maritime strike operations.
It will bolster India's maritime security architecture and defence capabilities.
The Defence Research and Development Organisation DRDO today conducted a successful flight trial
of the indigenously developed high-altitude platform.
On its successful flight trial, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh congratulated the team, saying
it is an important milestone in India's Atman-Irbhar Bharat journey towards realizing
a long-endurance stratospheric airship.
This is Aakashwani giving you the news.
The Union Cabinet today passed a resolution congratulating Prime Minister Narendra Modi
for completing 25 years as the head of government.
Mr. Modi first became the Chief Minister of Gujarat on 7th of October 2001.
He went on to become the Prime Minister in 2014 and tomorrow, he will complete 25 years
at the helm of government.
Addressing the media after the Cabinet meeting in New Delhi, Information and Broadcasting Minister
Ashwini Vaishnav said, Prime Minister Modi's 25-year tenure is a testimony to the strength
of Indian democracy.
Honourable Prime Minister Narendra Modi is completing 25 years as the head of a
government. In recognition of his continuous service to the nation, the cabinet congratulated
him and passed the resolution. During his tenure in Gujarat, the Prime Minister brought
about several significant changes through his works and policies, for which he was honored
around the world. The initiatives undertaken by him later become important template for
the country. Thus, the Gujarat model gained recognition and appreciation globally, and
several of its successful approaches were subsequently implemented across India.
India or Bharat-Bharmu's implementation.
Prime Minister Modi's 25-year journey in public service has been defined by the mantra of
Jan Seva Sedeesh Seva and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for
Seva and Sushasana, the government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the
goal of a Vixit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment,
this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring
you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through the UPI.
India's digital payments ecosystem has undergone a remarkable transformation. It is driven
by the vision of creating a simple and secure payment system accessible to every citizen.
The unified payments interface UPI, developed by the National Payments Corporation of India,
has emerged as a cornerstone of India's digital payments revolution. Today, UPI
India is now accepted in 11 countries with Greece and the Maldives being the latest to
adopt India's real-time payment platform.
Addressing the Global FinTech Fest 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted that
UPI is no longer confined to domestic borders. UPI was launched on 25th August in 2016 and
And in just a decade, UPI has transformed the scale of digital payments in the country,
making transactions faster, simpler and more accessible.
Talking to Akashwani News, Saraniam Singh, a resident of Patna, said he used to check
if he had enough cash in his wallet before stepping out, but now he easily pays for tea,
auto rides, groceries or meals in seconds by using UPI.
There was a time when stepping out meant checking whether I had enough cash in my
wallet.
Today, that routine has completely changed.
I can pay for a cup of tea, not to ride, groceries or a meal within seconds.
I can split a bill with a friend or send money to someone instantly without carrying cash
or looking for an ATM."
As of 2025, UBI accounts nearly 49% of the world's real-time payment transaction volume.
Today, UBI is not just a payment system, but a people's platform that made financial
transactions faster, simpler, transparent and inclusive.
Vedaman Yadav, Manu Pratap Singh, Akashwani News, Delhi.
India has strongly condemned the attacks on commercial vessels in the Black Sea and the
Strait of Hormuz, in which two foreign seafarers were killed and several crew members, including
Indian nationals, were injured. New Delhi has called for an immediate end to attacks
on commercial shipping and urged dialogue and diplomacy to restore safe navigation
through international waterways. The government has appointed Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit
as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff in the rank of Air Chief Marshal with effect from the
afternoon of 31st of this month. He will succeed Air Chief Marshal Amarpreet Singh.
Voting concluded peacefully for by-elections to five assembly constituencies in Tamil
Nadu, Puducherry and West Bengal along with the Lok Sabha seat in Assam. Polling took
place for Madhurantakam and Dharapuram seats in Tamil Nadu, Thattantawadi in Puducherry
and Rajinagar and Nandigram in West Bengal. Voting was also held for Nagav Lok Sabha
seat in Assam. The counting of votes will be taken up on Friday. The assembly seats
fell vacant following the resignation of the sitting legislators while the Nagav Lok Sabha
seat was vacated after the resignation of Congress leader Pradyut Bodalue.
Senior BJP leader and Union Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiran Rajiju has criticized
Congress party and leader of opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi for repeatedly targeting
election commission of India and other constitutional bodies. Talking to the media in New Delhi
Today, Mr. Rajidu said political parties should serve the people and accept the electoral
mandate.
Every day, the drama that Rahul Gandhi and the Congress Party keep creating over the
election commission and the repeated attacks they make on the Supreme Court needs to stop
now.
In a democracy, if you serve the people, you will receive the mandate.
If you fail to get the people's mandate and then abuse the election commission,
election, that is not the way forward." Earlier in the day, opposition parties held
a protest march from Parliament House to Nirvachan's southern, the headquarters of the election
commission of India in the national capital, over alleged irregularities in the special
intensive revision process and demanding the resignation of chief election commissioner
Gyanesh Kumar. However, security personnel stopped the protesters near Akashwani Bhavan
as they headed towards the election commission. Later, leader of the opposition in the Lok
Sabha and Congress MP Rahul Gandhi, along with party leader Priyanka Gandhi-Vadra and
other supporters, entered Akashwani Bhavan and staged a protest on the premises. Delhi
police detained them in the evening. Briefing media in New Delhi this afternoon, BJP spokesperson
Dr. Sudhanshu Trivedi said the Congress first family, which for the past four
generations ran a monarchical rule by strangling democracy attempted to intrude into Akashwani
today under the guise of democracy. He said, Rahul Gandhi is engaged in misleading the entire
nation with baseless, incoherent and false statements.
The Nobel Prize in Physics, 2026, has been awarded to Belgian-born scientist Francis
Hudson, who turned an enormous block of ice at the South Pole into a detector for
ghostly particles called neutrinos that reach Earth from outer space.
Making the announcement, the Nobel Committee today said 82-year-old Professor Halson, a
particle physicist at the University of Wisconsin-Madison in the United States, won the prize for decisive
contributions to the ice cube neutrino observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos
of astrophysical origin.
He receives a prize of $1.2 million.
The U.S. House of Representatives has introduced a bipartisan resolution honoring Indian pilot
Smith-Mutcher, the crew and passengers of Flight Dubai Flight 1073 for their actions during
an alleged cockpit attack.
With regard to today's opposition's protest, the Election Commission has clarified that
the new political party had sought an appointment till 4 p.m. to meet the Commission through
its representatives in a press statement.
The commission said that however at around 4 p.m. It received information from the Delhi police that a delegation of members of Parliament led by
Leader of the opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi want to meet the Commission and submit a memorandum
In men's cricket, West Indies have set a target of 172 runs for host Indian first T20 of five match series in Lucknow
In reply, India were 35 for two in 3.3 overs when reports last came in
Earlier put into bat, the visitors were bowled out for 171 runs in 19.1 overs.
And now, before we end the bulletin, the headlines once again.
Government approved setting up of Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority to streamline
multimodal planning, clears 10,000 crore rupees small and medium enterprises growth
fund, Prime Minister Narendra Modi hails decision as major boost to MSME sector.
Union Cabinet congratulates Prime Minister Narendra Modi on completing 25 years of
continuous leadership as head of government. Defense Ministry inked 660 crore rupee contract
to procure Brahmos' five-control system and launches for Indian Navy ships. Belgian-born
scientist Francis Halson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for discovery of high-energy
neutrinos of astrophysical origin.
